title: Flow Orchestration and Task Management
summary: This module defines the core Flow class for orchestrating multi-step AI agent workflows, managing state, handling human feedback, and providing persistence and visualization capabilities. It also includes specialized task types like conditional execution and hallucination guardrails.

nodes.label: Flow
nodes.title: Core Flow Definition
nodes.description: The central class for defining and managing multi-step AI agent workflows, handling execution, state, and interactions.

nodes.label: Flow Metaclass
nodes.title: Flow Metaclass
nodes.description: Metaclass responsible for introspecting Flow classes, registering start methods, listeners, and routers during class creation.

nodes.label: Kickoff Flow Execution
nodes.title: Initiate Flow Execution
nodes.description: Starts the workflow, handling initial state setup, event emission, and execution of designated start methods, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous modes.

nodes.label: Resume Paused Flow
nodes.title: Continue Flow After Pause
nodes.description: Resumes a flow that was paused for human feedback, processing the feedback and triggering subsequent steps.

nodes.label: Restore From Pending
nodes.title: Load Paused Flow State
nodes.description: Reconstructs a Flow instance from a persisted state that was paused awaiting human feedback.

nodes.label: Execute Flow Method
nodes.title: Run Individual Flow Method
nodes.description: Handles the execution of individual methods within a flow, including event emission, context management, and error handling.

nodes.label: Manage Listeners
nodes.title: Orchestrate Method Triggers
nodes.description: Manages the execution of methods (listeners and routers) triggered by the completion of other flow methods, supporting parallel and conditional execution.

nodes.label: Evaluate Conditions
nodes.title: Determine Flow Path
nodes.description: Evaluates complex AND/OR conditions to determine which methods should be triggered next in the workflow, supporting nested logic.

nodes.label: Initialize Flow State
nodes.title: Setup Flow Data State
nodes.description: Creates and initializes the flow's internal state, including unique identifiers and default values, and updates it with inputs.

nodes.label: Persist Flow State
nodes.title: Save Flow Progress
nodes.description: Provides an abstract interface for saving and loading the flow's state to a persistence backend, ensuring durability and resumability.

nodes.label: Request User Input
nodes.title: Prompt for Human Input
nodes.description: Allows the flow to request and receive input from a human user, blocking execution until input is provided or a timeout occurs.

nodes.label: Process Human Feedback
nodes.title: Handle Human Review & Decisions
nodes.description: Manages the process of requesting, receiving, and interpreting human feedback, potentially collapsing free-form text into predefined outcomes using an LLM.

nodes.label: Generate Flow Plot
nodes.title: Visualize Flow Structure
nodes.description: Creates an interactive HTML visualization of the flow's structure, showing methods, connections, and dependencies.

nodes.label: Interactive Diagram UI
nodes.title: Flow Visualization Interface
nodes.description: Provides the interactive user interface components for exploring and highlighting nodes and edges within the generated flow diagram.

nodes.label: Conditional Task
nodes.title: Dynamically Executed Task
nodes.description: A specialized task type that executes only if a specified condition, based on previous task output, evaluates to true.

nodes.label: Hallucination Guardrail
nodes.title: Task Output Validation
nodes.description: A placeholder task component designed to validate outputs against hallucination criteria, ensuring factual accuracy (premium feature).

nodes.label: Replay Recorded Events
nodes.title: Re-dispatch Past Events
nodes.description: Dispatches previously recorded method execution events, typically during flow resumption from a checkpoint, to re-establish state and context.

nodes.label: Reload Flow State
nodes.title: Update Flow from Execution Data
nodes.description: Restores the flow's execution ID, completed methods, and state from a provided execution data dictionary, enabling resumption.

nodes.label: Flow Analysis Utilities
nodes.title: Graph & Code Analysis Tools
nodes.description: Collection of utility functions for analyzing flow structure, method signatures, and code to extract information for visualization and internal logic.

nodes.label: Flow Decorators
nodes.title: Define Flow Behavior
nodes.description: Decorators used to mark methods as start points, listeners, or routers, defining the control flow and triggering conditions within a Flow.

nodes.label: Task Model Deserialization
nodes.title: Reconstruct Task Models
nodes.description: Utility for rehydrating Pydantic model class references from serialized checkpoint data, used in task and flow restoration.

groups.label: Flow Orchestration
groups.title: Core Flow Execution & Control
groups.description: Manages the lifecycle of a Flow, from initiation and method execution to listener management and event replay.

groups.label: State & Persistence
groups.title: Flow State Management & Storage
groups.description: Handles the initialization, updating, and durable storage of the flow's internal state, including mechanisms for resuming from checkpoints.

groups.label: Flow Control Logic
groups.title: Conditional Flow Routing
groups.description: Provides mechanisms for defining and evaluating complex conditions (AND/OR) that dictate the branching and triggering of methods within a flow.

groups.label: Human Interaction & Feedback
groups.title: Human-in-the-Loop Processes
groups.description: Facilitates interaction with human users, allowing flows to request input and process feedback to guide execution or validate outputs.

groups.label: Flow Visualization
groups.title: Interactive Flow Diagrams
groups.description: Generates interactive visual representations of flow structures, enabling users to understand and explore complex workflows.

groups.label: Specialized Tasks
groups.title: Advanced Task Definitions
groups.description: Defines specific types of tasks that extend basic functionality, such as conditional execution and guardrails for output validation.
